responseMessageContents.text:
Direct GitHub billing link:

**https://github.com/settings/billing**

For GitHub Actions spending specifically:

**https://github.com/settings/billing/summary**

If the repository is billed through an organization instead of your personal account, use:

**https://github.com/organizations/ibb142/settings/billing**

Resolve the failed payment or raise the Actions spending limit there, then reply: **“GitHub Actions billing restored.”**
